items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1959-11-08
items.q: Well, me, me, me and Wooden Joe, alright. Wooden Joe played with us a long time.

ctx.x: Did you use two trumpets? Seems like somebody told me they played trumpet with you for a while. You know who played with me? Wooden Joe. Oh yeah.

Wooden Joe played two trumpets with us? I used to, we used to play parade, we had a brass band, we had a pretty good brass band. Well, me, me, me and Wooden Joe, alright. Wooden Joe played with us a long time. And uh, Russ, he played trumpet with us at Moulin Rouge during the time of the war. He was in the Navy. Who was that then?

items.title: "Wooden Joe" Nicholas Interview, 1956-11-12
items.q: Kid Thomas was telling us. He used to play with you.

ctx.x: Yeah. Did you ever play much in brass bands on the street? I know I used to hear you a few years ago. Yeah. Oh, Kid Thomas was telling us. He used to play with you. Yeah.
I played in all of them brass bands and played many, many, many, many, many. Three years ago.
